question: Can the map page read the reader limits without evaluating any zod schema, so its first load has no frame
over 100 ms?
method: As S9.6u: runtime ulpin-reh-23 started from its own checkout and stopped after; base (c372be86) and this branch
built and previewed against it at once; Chromium from E:/ms-playwright headed with ANGLE D3D11, 1440x900, a
Studio window open 5 s before the map window (the OGC LoD2 package area), long animation frame entries mapped
through each build's source maps; eight alternating runs each. Chunks were also timed alone (three times each).

moved.to: packages/contracts/src/reader-limits.ts (no zod; its only runtime import is usp/intake-needs.ts)
notes: Each definition and its comment moved unchanged; each old module imports it back and re-exports it under the
same name. LARGE_ORIGINAL_LIMITS moved too because LARGE_ORIGINAL_V2_LIMITS reads its partBytes; it is not
added to upload-reader-limits. INTAKE_TABLE_READER_FORMATS stays in usp/intake-needs.ts and is re-exported.
No constant is computed from a schema, so none was left in place.
upload-reader-limits.ts re-exports reader-limits.ts only, now also INTAKE_TARGET_LIMITS and
INTAKE_EVIDENCE_LIMITS; upload-reader-limits.d.ts declares those two. Studio run/model.ts, evidence/api.ts and
All 23 values equal the base commit's exports (deep equality, same Object.isFrozen; scratch values.mts).

build.base: map start evaluates upload-reader-limits (97 KB, zod and 15 schema modules; 46-48 ms alone)
build.branch: map start evaluates reader-limits (5 KB, no zod; 7-9 ms alone); no reader schema module at all
stillAtMapStart: zod (schemas chunk, 86 KB, 12-13 ms alone), reached through evidence/citedRegion.ts, which imports
PacketRegionProvenanceSchema from packet-region.ts (and document-pages.ts schemas) into the EvidenceContext
chunk, and through CANONICAL_TARGETS from @ulpin/contracts (canonical/targets.ts, which also builds
schemas) in intake/table/model.ts and recipe.ts. Both are Studio lines outside this task. Nothing else at
map start is over 15 ms besides the entry module evaluation below.

mapCodeLoads.otherScripts: query notify 52-58 ms and warm-up compile 46 ms, in their own frames under 100 ms, both builds
reading: Evaluation fell by about 33 ms in every run. When it lands in the first render frame (about 60-66 ms with no
script) the merged frame is 93-100 ms on the branch against 131-136 ms on base. Target met: no frame over
100 ms; one run reached exactly 100 ms, so the margin is small. Removing zod from map start (the two paths
above, about 12 ms) is the remaining lever.

tests: apps/studio src/types/contracts-plain.test.ts: reader-limits.ts, types stripped, loads as data-URL modules
where no package resolves (only usp/intake-needs.ts reached); its export names are exactly the 23 moved values
and each equals, with the same freezing, what its old home exports; documentScannedPages agrees with the old
export. The existing plain.ts test now resolves paths from packages/contracts/src.
notVisual: No screen, text or layout change.
scratch: E:/ulpin-tmp/s9-6v (graph.mjs, mapload.mjs, imp.mjs, values.mts, base1-8.json, branch1-8.json, logs)

pins.place: packages/contracts/src/reader-limits.ts right after the moved module each list names first
twin: scripts/usp/obj/server.py code_files, same position; both lists parse to the same 9 paths in order
(scratch twin.mjs against the Python list read with ast)
untouched: KML, GeoParquet, CityJSON validation, streamed profile, semantic chunk and private MVT lists name
no moved module. apps/api/src/modules/evidence/operation-manifest.json schemaSource names document-pages.ts
but feeds the published schema, not a reader or converter pin, so it stays as it is.
testsAndFixtures: None updated: every test computes these hashes from the live lists, and the stored hashes
in the configs (pre-OBJ, pre-glTF, pre-buffer aliases) are historic values that stay.
